svg.title: Flower Anatomy Drag & Drop
svg.desc: Static SVG learning interface for flower anatomy with word bank, label slots, and popup panels using anchor navigation

g.text: — drag labels from word bank to slots —
SIMULATED INTERACTIVITY • PURE SVG NO JS
Click a pill to focus its slot via anchor • Use Hint, Check Answer, Reset buttons above for popups • Close popups with X
This is a textbook-style static simulation.
10 dashed slots point to flower parts with arrows.
Pills are styled as draggable: shadow, grip dots, rounded.
Buttons open layered <g> popups via #anchor navigation.
Pistil: Female part = stigma + style + ovary
Style: Tube connecting stigma to ovary
Receptacle: Base where all parts attach
Pure SVG, no JS. Popups use CSS :target. Click Hint, Check,
Reset to open layers. Close with X which links to #top.
1800×1200 • textbook UI • vector only • print ready
Here are placement clues for each part. Close and try again.
Vertical central line. Sticky top → tube → swollen base.
Left side slots, top to bottom order.
Green, bottom-most. Sepal = leaf under petal, Receptacle = base hub.
Big colorful petal, yellow anther on thin stalk filament.
Stamen = male unit. Pistil = female unit (all three).
• Attract (petal) is biggest and outermost • Protect (sepal) is green and lowest • Male (stamen) has pollen dust
• Female (pistil) is central sticky → tube → ovary • Receptacle is the anchor everything sits on
#hint:target { display:block } • Close links to #top to hide • No JS, only CSS :target and SVG layers
All 10 labels matched to their target zones. Dashed slots become solid when correct.
1. Petal — outer colorful leaf, attracts pollinators
Slot: right top, connects to big pink shape
2. Sepal — green protective leaf at base
4. Pistil — female organ = stigma + style + ovary
5. Anther — yellow pollen sac at tip
8. Style — tube between stigma and ovary
10. Receptacle — base where all parts attach
Slot: left lower-mid, just above stem
Teaching tip: Have students explain function before name. Petal = advertisement, Sepal = helmet, Anther = factory, Stigma = landing pad.
All popups closed. Word bank restored.
In this static version, reset simply returns to #top anchor,
clearing :target states. No data is stored — pure SVG layers.
<a href="#top"> clears the URL hash, so .popup:target no longer matches and display:none returns.
© Textbook UI • Flower Anatomy • Static SVG • No JS • Anchor-based interaction • 1800×1200
